topics.title: BI 3031185 / mGluR4 NAM, Impulsivity (BPD/ADHD) — Development Plan & China Update

background.text: Ph1b (1516-0003) FPI Jan 2025; key results Aug 2026. Impurity found during MRD may delay timeline; further test ongoing.
background.quote: Impurity found during MRD may delay timeline. Further test is ongoing.

background.text: China 1:1 consultations ongoing: Prof. Jun Tong (Wuhan Mental Health Center) reports ~20/month BPD patients, most presenting with impulsivity; a BPD database (~270 cases, >80 with impulsivity assessment) identified. Consultation with Prof. Zhen Wang (Shanghai Mental Health Center) planned 19 Dec.
background.quote:
China Update: 1:1 consultations to understand BPD and impulsivity in BPD in China
Prof. Jun Tong (童俊) from Wuhan Mental Health Center:
~20/month BPD patients in outpatient clinic.
Most BPD patients present due to impulsivity symptoms.
A database for BPD (~ 270 cases) with impulsivity assessment results (＞80 cases) has been identified.
Consultation with Prof. Zhen Wang (王振) from Shanghai Mental Health Center is planned on Thursday (19th Dec).

for_endorsement.text: Path to PoC strategy (incl. PoC design) to be endorsed in IUEC Q1 2026.
for_endorsement.quote: Path to PoC strategy (incl. PoC design) will be endorsed in IUEC Q1 2026.

todo.text: Key insights from China consultations to be reported back to global in Jan/Feb 2026 after all consultations are completed. Owner: China team (original text未说明具体负责人). Status: ongoing.
todo.quote: Key insights will report back to global in Jan/Feb 2026 after all consultations are completed.
